title: PAI Papers: Lab Report Series on Local and Hierarchical Coding Agents
description:
Measured experiments running agentic coding workers on local open-weight models on one Apple-silicon workstation, against cloud yardsticks, and in a hierarchy where a cloud planner directs local implementing workers.

This record is the source archive of the series. Each paper has its own record with the PDF to read and download:

  • Paper 1: Local Models as Coding Workers and Retrieval Engines on a Single Workstation
  • Paper 2: Local Coding Agents on One Workstation, Second Night
  • Paper 3: Quantisation, Serving and Harness Repair
  • Paper 4: Planner and Worker: When a Cloud Planner over a Local Coder Pays Off
